outputs: Generated answers to open-ended video questions

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as it's not mentioned in the paper. Added proper NLG task categories (Video Question Answering and Text-to-Video Retrieval). Added missing datasets used for evaluation. Normalized task names to standard forms.
Normalized all recall metrics to 'Recall@K' as they represent the same metric family. Kept 'Accuracy' and added 'Average Recall' which is explicitly mentioned in the paper.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and focuses on model architecture comparisons.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on video-and-language learning with a novel single-frame training approach. While it involves NLG tasks (video question answering), the primary contribution is in model architecture and training methodology rather than NLG evaluation methodology. The paper uses standard automatic metrics but does not explore LLM-based or human evaluation approaches.
